title: Not Suitable for Professional Use – Only Okay for Basic Home Use
body: I've been using this laptop for a couple of months, and overall it has been a disappointing experience, especially for office work. I even faced a screen light‑leak issue within a short time of usage. Professional Use Review: Significant lag while using VDI and during Microsoft Teams calls. With just 3 Chrome tabs + Teams call + Outlook + VDI, the system struggles even though it has 16GB RAM and 1TB SSD. Cursor movement becomes delayed and unresponsive. Teams messages take a long time to load while on a call, making it very difficult to work smoothly. HP Health Check says everything is fine, but the issues remain unfixed. Home Use Review: OTT apps load well, but the light leak issue on the screen corners is still a concern. Brightness is not sufficient; I often need to keep it at high levels, and it still feels dim. Speakers are extremely weak. Even at 100% volume, it sounds like 30%. My phone speakers are louder. Same issue during Teams calls—audio output is very poor. Final Verdict: Good only for basic home use like watching videos or light browsing. Not recommended for professional work, multitasking, or long video calls. Display quality and speakers are below expectations, and the performance issues severely impact productivity. title: Powerful, portable and dynamic
body: The battery life is impressive.. You get to 15 hours of battery life - I found that I can easily get 6+ hours doing intensive tasks. It gets to 50% recharge in just 45 minutes with HP Fast Charger. The graphics card is great and handles my Photoshop tasks with ease. It's worth noting that this isn't a gaming laptop in terms of its internals and design but I have had a go at some basic games which run fine. It has 2x USB-A ports, 2x USB-C, 1x HDMI, 1x display. I love the keyboard (it's not clunky or noisy) and I really like how big the trackpad is. I massively recommend this 14 inch flip book which caters for most needs, gives impressive viewing angles and is really convenient to carry round. - ![Image 1 of customer photos](https://i5.walmartimages.com/dfw/6e29e393-56ac/k2-_4522095d-ea13-4340-985b-60e8d25c7749.v1.jpg?odnWidth=150&odnHeight=150&odnBg=ffffff) - ![Image 2 of customer photos](https://i5.walmartimages.com/dfw/6e29e393-fe26/k2-_b30ce7c4-b7be-48b0-a28f-0fef4e385223.v1.jpg?odnWidth=150&odnHeight=150&odnBg=ffffff) - ![Image 3 of customer photos](https://i5.walmartimages.com/dfw/6e29e393-2b90/k2-_fab39e35-1b31-42d1-8aa9-fb67a4e7006c.v1.jpg?odnWidth=150&odnHeight=150&odnBg=ffffff) International review Review from **influenster.com** Helpful?(0) (0) 6VADLHF20IRR16611304092 ---
